name: Bowl visit versus confirmed drinking
subject: The small tricolor puppy with floppy ears, black back, tan head, and white paws.
scene_context: The designated bowl is the low white bowl on the wooden floor near the wooden post. The nearby round metal bowl is a different object.

rules.owner_request: Let me know if my puppy has not visited its designated bowl for 10 seconds of continuous monitoring.
rules.event_definition: A visit occurs when the target puppy places its muzzle at or inside the designated white bowl. Detect the visit intervals for this clip; the temporal engine will evaluate the 10-second absence condition. A visit does not require proof of eating or drinking.

rules.owner_request: Track whether my puppy actually drinks from the designated bowl.
rules.event_definition: Drinking requires visible evidence of liquid consumption, such as repeated tongue-lapping at a visible liquid surface. A lowered head, a muzzle in a bowl, or an assumed bowl purpose alone does not establish drinking. If the relevant mouth action or bowl contents are obscured, report unknown rather than claiming no drinking occurred.
